request.prompt:
Goods: Ballpoint pens with plastic body
Country of origin: CN

Choose the chapter that covers these goods. Options:
- 96: Miscellaneous manufactured articles
    contains 960830: Pens; fountain, stylograph and other pens
    contains 960899: Pens and pencils; duplicating stylos, pen-holders, pencil-holders, and similar holders, parts of the articles of heading 9608, including caps and clips
    contains 960820: Pens; felt tipped and other porous-tipped pens and markers
    contains 960810: Pens; ball point
    contains 960860: Pens; ball-point, refills comprising the ball point and ink-reservoir
    contains 960891: Pens; nibs and nib points
    contains 960850: Pen and pencil sets; of articles from two or more of the foregoing sub-headings
    contains 960840: Pencils; propelling or sliding
- 39: Plastics and articles thereof
    contains 391690: Plastics; monofilament, of plastics n.e.c. in heading no. 3916, cross-sectional dimension exceeds 1mm, rods, sticks and profile shapes, whether or not surface-worked but not otherwise worked
    contains 392330: Plastics; carboys, bottles, flasks and similar articles, for the conveyance or packing of goods
    contains 392340: Plastics; spools, cops, bobbins and similar supports, for the conveyance or packing of goods
    contains 392329: Plastics; sacks and bags (including cones), for the conveyance or packing of goods, of plastics other than ethylene polymers
    contains 392310: Plastics; boxes, cases, crates and similar articles for the conveyance or packing of goods
    contains 391729: Plastics; tubes, pipes and hoses thereof, rigid, of plastics n.e.c. in heading no. 3917
    contains 392390: Plastics; articles for the conveyance or packing of goods n.e.c. in heading no. 3923
    contains 392350: Plastics; stoppers, lids, caps and other closures, for the conveyance or packing of goods
    contains 391710: Plastics; artificial guts (sausage casings) of hardened protein or of cellulosic materials
    contains 392099: Plastics; plates, sheets, film, foil and strip (not self-adhesive), of plastics n.e.c. in heading no. 3920, non-cellular and not reinforced, laminated, supported or similarly combined with other materials
- 32: Tanning or dyeing extracts; tannins and their derivatives; dyes, pigments and other colouring matter; paints, varnishes; putty, other mastics; inks
    contains 320300: Colouring matter of vegetable or animal origin, including dyeing extracts not animal black, whether or not chemically defined; preparations based on colouring matter of vegetable or animal origin
- 44: Wood and articles of wood; wood charcoal
    contains 441700: Wood; tools, tool bodies, tool handles, broom or brush bodies and handles, boot and shoe lasts and trees, of wood

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: Ball point pens are specifically covered by heading 9608 (subheading 960810) in Chapter 96, regardless of plastic body material.
